correctness.rationale: Exact source update substitution produces the two conditional matrices, and independent coordinate sampling gives an exact three-component symmetric covariance transfer at all finite steps. Its Taylor matrix has two order-t upper-superdiagonal links and a positive order-t^2 closing link, yielding the characteristic limit z^3=2(d-1)/d^4 under lambda=1-2t/d+t^(4/3)z. Distinct eigenvalue branches and nonvanishing positive left/right projections of the specified initialized expectation make the positive branch the actual asymptotic expected-objective ratio. Rational enumeration (168 finite identities) and 12 numerical spectral cases ran successfully, but are only corroboration. Fixed-dimension/small-positive-curvature and order-of-limits restrictions are explicit.
